To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of oral services among older Chileans is low and the main barrier for the non-use of these services is dental fear.

1) older adults with more dental problems and those with secondary and higher education are more likely to visit the dentist, while those living in rural communities and with self-reported dental fear are less likely to visit the dental care services, 2) the main reasons for not visiting dental services are related to the cost and distance to dental clinics.
older adults in Chile have a low utilization rate of dental services, which is influenced by the level of education, the place of residence (urban/rural), and dental fear.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the need to improve access to oral health care services for older people in Chile.
identifying barriers to dental care and factors associated with use of dental care services in Chile.
identifying the factors that influence the patterns of use oral health services in Chilean older adults.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of dental health services in Chile is still a problem and that the government should implement a national policy to improve the oral health care system.
the use of dental care services among the elderly is low and that it is important to identify barriers to dental care use and to develop strategies to increase use of dental care among older adults.
the use of dental care services among the elderly population of Chile is low.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of oral healthcare services in the elderly population of Chile is low.
the oral health care services utilization among the Chilean population is still very limited and that the oral health status of the population is poor.

the use of oral healthcare services is associated with the presence of oral health problems, and that the use of these services is influenced by sociodemographic characteristics, oral health status, and self-reported dental fear.
The main takeaway from our work is that
older adults with more severe oral health problems are more likely to visit a dentist.
the Chilean health system should be reformed in order to increase access to oral health services for older people.
older adults who have more dental fear and those who live in rural areas may be more at risk of not using dental services.
